ByteLength.description: Canonical uint64 byte length. Range requires semantic validation.

oneOf.description: Formula/cache snapshot only. Does not open or recalculate a workbook.

colors.description: Every declared fill/line color is evaluated once, without quantized reuse.

retainedOrdinals.description: Geometry, extensions and unknown attributes remain source-bound.

oneOf.description: ECMA does not give coefficients. This profile explicitly uses 22/72/6.
2016 table says 250,250,120 for ltGoldenrodYellow, unlike its long alias.

ColorProfile.description: A named, provisional numerical interpretation, not an Office/WPS certificate.

rgba8.description: Never feed these quantized samples back into native expressions.

Emu.description: Signed int64 EMU. 1 point = 12700 EMU. Range requires semantic validation.

NativeCoordinate.description: Native coordinate: bounded integer EMU or exact decimal universal measure.

NativePercentage.description: Exact native percentage: int32 thousandths of a percent or decimal percent; ranges depend on use.

oneOf.description: DrawingML chart text properties; retains its actual chart namespace.
DrawingML chart rich text; not a presentation shape text body.
Native table-style font collection; stored in the table style catalog.

index.description: Native idx for dLbl/legendEntry only; sparse values stay sparse.

nodes.description:
Physical source order. Parent ordinals refer to chart, plot, series, axis
or another annotation; no synthetic shape/object IDs are allocated.

textBodies.description: One catalog per real c:txPr/c:rich body, including chart/axis defaults.

levels.description: Source level order; no expansion of sparse point indices or missing values.

nativeKind.description: Native container name; distinguishes reference, literal and title text.

autoUpdate.description: None means omitted; no eager refresh is performed by inspection.

markup.description: Complex markup remains bound to its original part and physical ordinal.

properties.description: Source order; missing property, missing val and explicit lexical val differ.

retainedAttributeOrdinals.description: Known elements carrying attributes that this declaration model does not interpret.

sourceLinked.description: Preserve omission and the actual lexical boolean; no workbook lookup.

chart.description: Series and point layout references bind to the declaration ordinals below.

declarations.description: Source order. This is not a resolved chart-style/series/point cascade.

textColors.description: Colors in native annotation text, evaluated in the same chart context.

annotations.description: Physical label, legend and title declarations, before inheritance/layout.

axes.description: Source declarations; reference resolution, defaults and geometry are separate.

dataAuthority.description: Cache declarations are snapshots, not recalculated workbook values.

extensionOrdinals.description:
Opaque extension roots remain physically bound even though inspection
does not interpret their descendants. Consumers must not silently admit.

nativeKind.description: Native local name (barChart, doughnutChart, ...), not a rendering capability.

value.description: Exact lexical value. Missing v, empty v, zero and errors remain distinct.
XML val attribute (or separator character data), without schema defaulting.

transforms.description: XML application order, including repeated transforms.

retainedOrdinals.description: Only this node's uninterpreted properties. Children have their own nodes.

Physical nodes in the immutable source part. Consumers must resolve or
diagnose these before claiming a complete brush.

embed.description: Relationship IDs only: the core never opens a network URL or file path.

retainedOrdinals.description: Uninterpreted properties only; known effects use the part catalog.

entries.description: Native order is significant, including repeated stop positions.

retainedOrdinals.description:
Unsupported attributes/extensions bind to their owning elements. They
cannot be discarded or counted as resolved line semantics.

roots.description:
Physical ordinals in this part, in discovery order. A root is a txBody,
txStyles, defaultTextStyle, fontRef, theme bodyPr/lstStyle or chart txPr/rich root.
Relationships are resolved later.

element.description: Native local name. Reader grammar validates its namespace and context.

retainedOrdinals.description: Uninterpreted attributes/subtrees cannot become resolved text semantics.

owner.description: Physical shape ID in this part; None for non-shape defaults and chart bodies.
